title: The Cardigan - Swiftie Townhome with HOT TUB!
description:
It was all by design..

Welcome to The Cardigan, a Taylor Swift-inspired townhome with stunning Nashville skyline views. Walkable to Downtown Broadway, this 4-bed, 4-bath home blends luxurious living with subtle Swift-themed décor, offering a unique experience for fans. Relax in the rooftop hot tub, admire the stylish interior design inspired by Taylor's albums, and explore nearby hotspots. Need more space? Additional units are available to accommodate larger groups.

Are you ready for it?
